messages.content:
You answer questions about the GitLab company handbook using ONLY the numbered passages provided.
- Base every statement on the passages and cite them like [1] or [2][3].
- If the passages do not contain the answer, reply exactly: "I don't know based on the handbook." Do not guess or use outside knowledge.
- If the answer depends on a country, entity or situation, say which one the passage covers.
- Be concise: at most 3 sentences.

Passages:
[1] [Global Expansion > **Global Expansion Benefits** > **United Arab Emirates 🇦🇪**]
Female workers receive 60 days of maternity leave structured as follows:

- **45 days:** Fully paid leave
- **15 days:** Half-paid leave (during probation period only)

**Application Timing:** To initiate parental leave, submit your time off by selecting parental leave category in [Workday - Time Off](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ZatJdGp485lOS2QVrxYJByQK8dD_CMGiLVOykgd338w/edit) at least 30 days before the leave starts. Please familiarize yourself with GitLabs [Parental leave policy](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave).

**Additional Maternity Provisions:**

- **Pregnancy/childbirth complications:** Additional 45 days unpaid leave available if unable to return to work due to illness resulting from pregnancy or childbirth. Medical certificate from respective medical authority required. Days may be taken consecutively or intermittently.
- **Sick or disabled child:** Additional 30 days fully paid leave, extendable for another 30 days unpaid. Medical certificate from respective medical authority required to prove child's illness or disability.
- **Nursing breaks:** After returning to work, entitled to one or two daily breaks for nursing (maximum one hour total per day) for 6 months following delivery. These breaks are fully paid.

**Sabbatical Leave (National Service)**

Under UAE Labour Law, Emirati citizens working in the private sector are entitled to paid sabbatical leave to perform national service.

**Sick Leave**

[2] [GitLab BV (Netherlands) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Time Off Policies > Sick Leave Support]
Comprehensive coverage when you're unable to work due to illness.

Leave Entitlement

* 100% salary for first 25 days
* 70% salary continuation for up to 104 weeks total
* GitLab complies with [Dutch local laws](https://business.gov.nl/regulation/reporting-employee-illness-recovery/) regarding sick leave. Local laws override any leave policy we have in the benefit of the team members

How to Report

* Select "Out Sick" in Workday

Employees of GitLab B.V. have further rights and responsibilities regarding sick time based on Dutch law, as written into their employment [contracts](https://internal.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/people-operations/people-operations/employment_contracts/):

[3] [GitLab Ireland Ltd > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family Leaves > Parental Leave]
Flexibility for ongoing childcare needs.  

Leave Entitlement

- Up to 26 weeks unpaid leave  
- For children under 12 (16 with disability)  
- Can split into blocks with manager approval  
- Requires 1 year employment

  

How to Apply

1. Notify leaves@gitlab.com 6 weeks in advance
2. Sign confirmation document 4 weeks before leave

[4] [PTY LTD Benefits > **We've Got You Covered:** > **Time Away & Leave Policies** > **Parental Leave**]
Comprehensive support for growing families, combining Australian statutory entitlements with GitLab's enhanced parental leave benefits.

Statutory Leave Entitlement

All team members are entitled to up to 12 months of unpaid parental leave if they have been at GitLab for at least 12 months. They can also request up to 12 months of additional unpaid parental leave.

Australian Government Parental Leave Payment

Team members may be eligible for pay from either or both of the following:

- [Australia's Government Parental Leave Pay Scheme](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/leave/parental-leave/during-parental-leave/payment-during-parental-leave#australian-government-parental-leave-pay)
- GitLab's Parental Leave

Eligible employees who are the carer of a child born or adopted from 1 July 2026 can get up to 26 weeks' Parental Leave Pay, which is paid at the National Minimum Wage. For more information visit [Services Australia -- Parental Leave Pay](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/parental-leave-pay)

- If you are applying for government-funded Parental Leave Pay, you can apply up to 3 months before your child's due date.

Applying for Parental Leave in Australia

- To initiate your parental leave, please enter the dates of your leave into Workday by selecting the `Parental Leave` label.

Record-keeping for paid Parental Leave:

[5] [PTY LTD Benefits > **We've Got You Covered:** > **Time Away & Leave Policies** > **Personal/Carer's Leave**]
1. Email leaves@gitlab.com at least 1 day prior to the start date (whenever possible)
   - Include a medical certificate or statutory declaration noting you weren't able to work because of an illness or injury, or needed to provide care or support to an immediate family or household member (because of an illness, injury, or unexpected emergency affecting the family member).
2. Select `Out Sick` in Workday to ensure that leave entitlements are properly tracked.
   - If you wish to take Carer's Leave but don't want to change your Slack status to Out Sick, send your Carer's Leave request to leaves@gitlab.com and the Absence Management team will manually add your leave to Workday and notify payroll.

Unpaid Carer's Leave

All team members are entitled to 2 days unpaid carer's leave.

**Eligibility:**

Team Members are eligible for 2 days unpaid carer's leave each time an immediate family member or household member of the employee needs care and support because of:

- Illness
- Injury or
- An unexpected emergency

Full-time team members can only get unpaid carer's leave if they don't have any paid sick / carer's leave left.

An immediate family member is a:

- spouse or former spouse
- de facto partner or former de facto partner
- child
- parent
- grandparent
- grandchild
- sibling, or
- child, parent, grandparent, grandchild or sibling of the employee's spouse or de facto partner (or former spouse or de facto partner).

[6] [GitLab Korea Limited Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family Leaves > Family Care Leave]
Leave to care for family members due to illness, accident, old age, or to care for a child.

Eligibility Requirements

- Minimum six months of GitLab employment
- Available for care of parent, grandparent, grandchild, child, spouse, or parent-in-law

Leave Entitlement

- **Short-term Family Care Leave**: Up to 10 days per year (unpaid), can be split over multiple occasions
- **Extended Family Care Leave**: Up to 90 days per year (unpaid), including any short-term leave taken. Minimum 30 days must be used at a time for extended leave.
- **How to Request**: Please provide advanced notice when possible. You can submit a Compass case to the Absence Management team for more information.

Important Dates/Details

- **Advance Notice**: 30 days required for all parental leave types
- **Documentation**: Medical certificates required for maternity leave
- **Coordination**: Work with Total Rewards team for insurance claims

Question: In Germany, can a team member who has already taken the maximum statutory parental leave days request an additional unpaid leave period to care for a child with a chronic illness, and if so, what documentation is required to have it approved by GitLab?
